import {
  getCameraPosition,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  projectWorldToScreen,
  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
export interface ShiftTracker { mark(): void; shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } }

type PixelViewport = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
type Mat4Like = Float32Array;

interface Snapshot {
  view: Mat4Like;
  viewProjection: Mat4Like;
  worldOrigin: Vec | null;
  viewport: PixelViewport;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
}

function finite(v: number) { return Number.isFinite(v); }
function copyMatrix(m: any): Float32Array {
  if (m instanceof Float32Array) return new Float32Array(m);
  if (typeof m?.length === 'number') return Float32Array.from(m as ArrayLike<number>);
  if (Array.isArray(m)) return Float32Array.from(m);
  // fallback identity? But better throw? Return Float32Array 16 zeros? 
  return new Float32Array(16);
}
function copyVec(v: any): Vec { return {x: v.x, y: v.y, z: v.z}; }

function positive(n: number, fallback: number) { return n > 0 && finite(n) ? n : fallback; }

function readViewport(camera: Camera, backingWidth: number, backingHeight: number): PixelViewport {
  try {
    const vp = resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
    if (vp.width > 0 && vp.height > 0) return {x: vp.x, y: vp.y, width: vp.width, height: vp.height};
  } catch {}
  return {x:0,y:0,width:backingWidth,height:backingHeight};
}

function takeSnapshot(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): Snapshot {
  const backingWidth = positive(canvas.width, positive(canvas.clientWidth, 1));
  const backingHeight = positive(canvas.height, positive(canvas.clientHeight, 1));
  const cssWidth = positive(canvas.clientWidth, backingWidth);
  const cssHeight = positive(canvas.clientHeight, backingHeight);
  const viewport = readViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  let aspect = 1;
  try { aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight); } catch {}
  if (!finite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) aspect = viewport.width / viewport.height;
  if (!finite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) aspect = backingWidth / backingHeight;
  const view = copyMatrix(getViewMatrix(camera));
  const viewProjection = copyMatrix(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect));
  let worldOrigin: Vec | null = null;
  try { worldOrigin = copyVec(getCameraPosition(camera)); } catch {}
  return {view, viewProjection, worldOrigin, viewport, backingWidth, backingHeight, cssWidth, cssHeight};
}

function project(snapshot: Snapshot, point: Vec): {x:number,y:number} {
  const options: any = {
    viewport: snapshot.viewport,
    backingWidth: snapshot.backingWidth,
    backingHeight: snapshot.backingHeight,
    cssWidth: snapshot.cssWidth,
    cssHeight: snapshot.cssHeight,
  };
  if (snapshot.worldOrigin) options.worldOrigin = snapshot.worldOrigin;
  const result = projectWorldToScreen(point, snapshot.view as any, snapshot.viewProjection as any, options);
  return {x: result.cssX, y: result.cssY};
}

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let snapshot = takeSnapshot(camera, canvas);
  return {
    mark() { snapshot = takeSnapshot(camera, canvas); },
    shift(point) {
      if (!point || !finite(point.x) || !finite(point.y) || !finite(point.z)) return {dx:0,dy:0};
      const current = takeSnapshot(camera, canvas);
      const prev = project(snapshot, point);
      const now = project(current, point);
      const dx = now.x - prev.x;
      const dy = now.y - prev.y;
      return { dx: finite(dx) ? dx : 0, dy: finite(dy) ? dy : 0 };
    }
  };
}

function takeSnapshot(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): Snapshot {
  const metrics = readCanvasMetrics(canvas);
  if (!metrics.valid) return makeInvalidSnapshot();
  const viewport = resolveViewport(camera, metrics.backingWidth, metrics.backingHeight);
  const aspect = resolveAspect(camera, metrics.backingWidth, metrics.backingHeight, viewport);
  let view: Float32Array | null = null;
  let viewProjection: Float32Array | null = null;
  try {
    view = copyMatrix(getViewMatrix(camera));
    viewProjection = copyMatrix(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect));
  } catch { view = null; viewProjection = null; }
  if (!view || !viewProjection) return makeInvalidSnapshot();
  const floatingOrigin = Boolean((camera as any)._useFloatingOrigin);
  let worldOrigin: Vec | null = null;
  if (floatingOrigin) {
    try { worldOrigin = copyVec(getCameraPosition(camera)); } catch {}
    if (!worldOrigin) return makeInvalidSnapshot();
  }
  return { valid:true, view, viewProjection, viewport, backingWidth: metrics.backingWidth, backingHeight: metrics.backingHeight, cssWidth: metrics.cssWidth, cssHeight: metrics.cssHeight, floatingOrigin, worldOrigin };
}
```
